units.source_text: 挺拔的杉林，树梢上还残留着的叶子稍呈圆形，

en.t: In the tall, straight cedar grove, the leaves still lingering on the treetops were slightly rounded,

units.source_text: 千重子把它看成是“冬天的花”。

en.t: and Chieko thought of them as flowers of winter.

units.source_text: 想来它也的确是冬天的花。

en.t: Come to think of it, they really were flowers of winter.
